text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (implementation starting with the 2021 Primary One cohort; updated October 2025). Whole Numbers, Multiplication and Division: pp. 31, 33 and 35; Four Operations: p. 37.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司：《小学一至六年级数学课程纲要》（2021 年版，2025 年 10 月更新）。整数·乘法与除法：第 31、33、35 页；四则运算：第 37 页。

note.en: The only source for what each step covers; the syllabus lines in the lesson are quoted from it. Pages as printed on the PDF; wording checked against the PDF on 2026-10-17.
note.zh: 每一步学什么，只以这份课纲为准；课里的课纲条目照原文引用。页码是 PDF 上印的页码；措辞于 2026-10-17 对照 PDF 核对。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: primary syllabuses page.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：小学课程纲要页面。

note.zh: 用于核对 S1 的版本。

text.en: TIMSS 2015 Encyclopedia. Singapore: The Mathematics Curriculum in Primary and Lower Secondary Grades. TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center, Boston College.
text.zh: 《TIMSS 2015 百科》新加坡条目：小学与初中的数学课程。波士顿学院 TIMSS & PIRLS 国际研究中心。

note.en: The Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract approach: objects grouped and blocks traded on the stage, the number sentence under them.
note.zh: 「具体—图像—抽象」教学法：舞台上把东西分组、把数位块换开，下面写算式。

text.en: Common Core Standards Writing Team (2011). Progressions for the Common Core State Standards in Mathematics: K, Counting and Cardinality; K–5, Operations and Algebraic Thinking. Tucson: Institute for Mathematics and Education, University of Arizona.
text.zh: 共同核心标准编写组（2011）：《共同核心数学标准进阶：幼儿园计数与基数；幼儿园至五年级运算与代数思维》。图森：亚利桑那大学数学与教育研究所。

note.en: Equal groups, arrays and the two kinds of division (how many in each group, how many groups); multiplication and division as one relationship (steps 01–06). The page lists the progressions documents; this one is linked from it.
note.zh: 相同的几组、阵列、除法的两种问法（每组几个、能分几组）；乘法和除法是同一种关系（第 01–06 步）。该页列出各进阶文件，这一册由此链接。

text.en: Common Core Standards Writing Team (2015). Progressions for the Common Core State Standards in Mathematics: K–5, Number and Operations in Base Ten. Tucson: Institute for Mathematics and Education, University of Arizona.
text.zh: 共同核心标准编写组（2015）：《共同核心数学标准进阶：幼儿园至五年级·十进制数与运算》。图森：亚利桑那大学数学与教育研究所。

note.en: Place-value blocks, trading, partial products and why the column methods work (steps 09–12). Linked from the same page as S4.
note.zh: 数位块、换、部分积，以及竖式为什么成立（第 09–12 步）。与 S4 在同一页面链接。

text.en: Fischbein, E., Deri, M., Nello, M. S. & Marino, M. S. (1985). The role of implicit models in solving verbal problems in multiplication and division. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 16(1), 3–17.
text.zh: Fischbein, E. 等（1985）：隐含模型在乘除文字题中的作用。《数学教育研究杂志》第 16 卷第 1 期，3–17 页。

note.en: Multiplication first understood as repeated addition and division as sharing; choosing the wrong operation (added-not-multiplied, operation-swapped). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 孩子先把乘法理解为连加、把除法理解为平均分；选错运算（把两个数相加、该除却乘）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Mulligan, J. T. & Mitchelmore, M. C. (1997). Young children's intuitive models of multiplication and division. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 28(3), 309–330.
text.zh: Mulligan, J. T. 与 Mitchelmore, M. C.（1997）：幼儿对乘法和除法的直觉模型。《数学教育研究杂志》第 28 卷第 3 期，309–330 页。

note.en: Counting one by one, skip counting and adding in groups; groups that are not equal; groups and their size swapped (steps 01–03). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 一个一个地数、跳着数、按组加；不等的几组；组数和每组个数对调（第 01–03 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Squire, S. & Bryant, P. (2002). The influence of sharing on children's initial concept of division. Journal of Experimental Child Psychology 81(1), 1–43.
text.zh: Squire, S. 与 Bryant, P.（2002）：平均分对儿童最初除法概念的影响。《实验儿童心理学杂志》第 81 卷第 1 期，1–43 页。

note.en: Sharing comes before grouping; children who know only sharing miss 'how many groups' stories (step 05, sharing-only). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 平均分先于包含除；只认平均分的孩子会漏掉「能分几组」的故事（第 05 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Silver, E. A., Shapiro, L. J. & Deutsch, A. (1993). Sense making and the solution of division problems involving remainders. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 24(2), 117–135.
text.zh: Silver, E. A. 等（1993）：有余数的除法题中的意义理解与解法。《数学教育研究杂志》第 24 卷第 2 期，117–135 页。

note.en: What to do with a remainder in a story: one more group, or left out; dropping it (step 08). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 故事里的余数怎么处理：再多一组，或者不算；丢掉余数（第 08 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Battista, M. T., Clements, D. H., Arnoff, J., Battista, K. & Van Auken Borrow, C. (1998). Students' spatial structuring of 2D arrays of squares. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 29(5), 503–532.
text.zh: Battista, M. T. 等（1998）：学生对二维正方形阵列的空间结构化。《数学教育研究杂志》第 29 卷第 5 期，503–532 页。

note.en: How children come to see the rows and columns of an array (steps 03 and 12). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 孩子怎样看出阵列的行和列（第 03、12 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Fuson, K. C., Wearne, D., Hiebert, J. C., Murray, H. G., Human, P. G., Olivier, A. I., Carpenter, T. P. & Fennema, E. (1997). Children's conceptual structures for multidigit numbers and methods of multidigit addition and subtraction. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 28(2), 130–162.
text.zh: Fuson, K. C. 等（1997）：儿童对多位数的概念结构及多位数加减法。《数学教育研究杂志》第 28 卷第 2 期，130–162 页。

note.en: Tens treated as ones; trading not done (steps 09 and 11). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 把十当成一；该换的没有换开（第 09、11 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Ashlock, R. B. (2010). Error Patterns in Computation: Using Error Patterns to Help Each Student Learn (10th ed.). Boston: Allyn & Bacon.
text.zh: Ashlock, R. B.（2010）：《计算中的错误模式》（第 10 版）。波士顿：Allyn & Bacon。

note.en: Typical column-method errors: a carry not added, place products written side by side, a 0 missing from the quotient, a remainder too big (steps 08, 10, 11).
note.zh: 竖式的典型错误：进位没有加、各位的积并排写、商中间漏写 0、余数比除数大（第 08、10、11 步）。

text.en: Izsák, A. (2004). Teaching and learning two-digit multiplication: Coordinating analyses of classroom practices and individual student learning. Mathematical Thinking and Learning 6(1), 37–79.
text.zh: Izsák, A.（2004）：两位数乘法的教与学。《数学思维与学习》第 6 卷第 1 期，37–79 页。

note.en: The area model and partial products; parts left out (step 12). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 面积模型与部分积；漏掉的部分积（第 12 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: NCETM. Primary Mastery Professional Development Materials, Spine 2: Multiplication and Division.
text.zh: 英国国家数学教学卓越中心（NCETM）：小学精熟教学专业发展资料，第二线「乘法与除法」。

note.en: Teaching order for equal groups, commutativity, the two structures of division, new tables from known ones and division with remainders (steps 01–08). Page checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 相同的几组、交换律、除法的两种结构、由会的乘法表推出新的、有余数的除法的教学顺序（第 01–08 步）。页面于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Anghileri, J. (1989). An investigation of young children's understanding of multiplication. Educational Studies in Mathematics 20(4), 367–385.
text.zh: Anghileri, J.（1989）：幼儿对乘法理解的调查。《数学教育研究》第 20 卷第 4 期，367–385 页。

note.en: Equal groups, repeated addition and counting in jumps along a number line; one jump too many or too few (steps 01 and 02). DOI checked 2026-10-18.
note.zh: 相同的几组、连加、在数轴上跳着数；多跳或少跳一次（第 01、02 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-18 核对。

text.en: Textbook series on the MOE approved list (for the usual order of topics and the words used in class only, not copied): Marshall Cavendish My Pals Are Here! Maths; Shaping Maths. Singapore Math Inc., Dimensions Math 2B Home Instructor's Guide (sample pages).
text.zh: 教育部批准目录上的教材系列（只参考通常的教学顺序和课堂用语，不照抄）：Marshall Cavendish《My Pals Are Here! Maths》、《Shaping Maths》。Singapore Math Inc.《Dimensions Math 2B》家庭教师指南（样页）。

note.en: Reading 4 × 3 as "4 groups of 3": the Dimensions Math 2B guide reads 3 × 4 as 3 groups of 4 and notes that the order is a convention; no My Pals Are Here! page could be checked online. Questions, pictures and wording in this lesson are our own.
note.zh: 把 4 × 3 读作「4 组、每组 3 个」：《Dimensions Math 2B》指南把 3 × 4 读作 3 组、每组 4 个，并说明这个顺序只是约定；《My Pals Are Here!》的页面无法在网上核对。本课的题目、插图和措辞都是自己写的。
